name: select
description: Coverage-greedy best-N view selection over the SfM track graph (STO-SCN-094). Greedy submodular maximization on the image-point incidence: marginal gain = newly-covered points (W_NEW) + triangulation-angle-weighted shared points (W_TRIANG x angle-quality tent peaking in 10-30 deg), subject to a connectivity constraint (a kept view shares >= min_overlap points with the selected set) and a viewpoint-diversity penalty (same-space views within div_angle are down-weighted). Emits the proposed-N (frame-index names + poses, in the posed.json shape the reconstruct graphs already consume) plus a coverage report (coverage %, triangulation-angle stats, view-spread) that STO-SCN-095 renders for the human. Gated behind covis (covis HARD-FAILs on a nebula, so a bad solve never reaches selection). Pure-stdlib; runs locally on the store's sparse/0. Lives under the solve it selects from.

n.note: target view count (downstream model's sweet spot; ~12-17 reconstruct graphs, ~32 DA3)

min_overlap.note: connectivity: shared pts a kept view must share with the selected set

div_angle.note: viewpoint-diversity: penalize same-space views within this optical-axis angle (0 = off)
